description: Bruitages et musiques du monde Sous-marin Narval (dossier /41/ des cartes SD).

sons.prompt: Deep submarine sonar ping echoing, followed by a low brass swell, underwater cinematic intro
Dark damaged submarine interior, metal hull creaking under pressure, water dripping, distant groans, seamless loop
Submarine interior with power restored, electrical hum, bilge pumps working, soft ventilation, distant creaks, seamless loop
Submarine emergency klaxon alarm, two-tone, echoing in metal corridors
Loud deep groan and crack of a steel submarine hull under water pressure
High pressure seawater jet spraying from a broken pipe inside a submarine
Heavy watertight door wheel turning with a screech, then the steel door swinging open with a thud
Small metal padlock clicking open, locker door opening
Flashlight click switching on
Submarine power coming back, breakers clicking, lights buzzing on, pumps spinning up
Electrical overload, sparks crackling and breaker tripping with a power-down whine
Submarine emergency ballast blow, roaring compressed air, hull groaning as the submarine starts rising
Single sonar ping underwater with long echo
Radio static and interference, naval radio
Single stroke of an old manual bilge pump, metallic clunk and splash
Dark tense underwater ambient music, slow heartbeat pulse, deep drones, seamless loop
Emotional uplifting orchestral swell, rising from the deep, hopeful sunrise
Water rushing in and filling a metal room, muffled underwater, dark low drone
Escape trunk flooding with seawater, rising water sound in a small metal chamber
Heavy submarine hatch unlocking and swinging open underwater, muffled
Ship intercom click and short crackle before someone speaks
Submarine hull scraping and sliding on rocks, deep metallic grinding
